ops.catering: Catering is limited to designated vendors; outside catering companies may not bring in food or drink. For the National Convention Hall, Conference Center, Exhibition Hall and Annex Hall, the only vendor is the Yokohama Grand InterContinental Hotel (up to 7,000 guests). For the North, the organizer chooses one company per event from the designated hotels (Yokohama Bay Hotel Tokyu and The Kahala Hotel & Resort Yokohama: up to around 500 guests; the Catering Service Guide PDF also lists Yokohama Royal Park Hotel). The catering company must be decided by 6 months before the event, and the menu and quantities by 1 month before. (Source: plan site, catering arrangements; Explanation of Important Matters 2025.9; Catering Service Guide PDF)
ops.restaurants: On the Exhibition Hall 2F: Ristorante Attimo (Italian), DANZERO (French), Pizza-La Express, Doutor Coffee Shop and 7-Eleven. On the Exhibition Hall 1F: Daily Yamazaki. On the North 2F: UNI COFFEE ROASTERY and Doutor Coffee Shop. On the Conference Center 6F: Bay Bridge Cafeteria (hotel-operated). Each tenant accepts "store parties". The restaurants of the Yokohama Grand InterContinental Hotel (Chinese, French, buffet, Japanese, lounge & bar) are also listed on the same page.
ops.prevDaySetup: The Exhibition Hall has a "setup and teardown" time category, and it can be rented in half-day units (0:00-12:00 / 12:00-24:00) only when it is continuous with a full-day rental (0:00-24:00). Prices including tax (from October 2026): ABCD, 4,092,000 yen per half day; B and D, 1,364,000 yen each; A and C, 682,000 yen each. The National Convention Hall has a "use on days other than the event day" category: for 1-8 hours, 1,597,200 yen on weekdays and 1,887,600 yen on Sat, Sun & holidays (tax included). For the Conference Center, Annex Hall and North as well, the rental time runs from unlocking to locking (including setup and teardown time). (Source: Exhibition Hall and National Convention Hall price list PDFs, from October 2026; Facility Usage Regulations, Appendix 2)
ops.waitingRooms: Waiting rooms are provided per building. The National Convention Hall has 11 waiting rooms and dressing rooms (N101 258 m² and others, special waiting rooms N302 89 m² and N303 20 m²); N101, N111 and N112 are included in the venue usage fee. The Exhibition Hall has 31 attached waiting rooms for Halls A-D (25-90 m²), which are included in the venue usage fee. The Conference Center has 10 waiting rooms (10-110 m²) and a special reception room of 46 m²; the Annex Hall has F1 18 m², F2 10 m² and the E23 VIP waiting room 69 m²; the North has 4 rooms, G101-G104 (30-74 m²). These have individual fees in the price lists, and the waiting rooms cannot be used on their own. (Source: capacity tables and price lists of each facility, from October 2026)
ops.loadingHours: Load-in and load-out is possible during the rental time itself (from unlocking to locking, including setup and teardown). The Exhibition Hall is rented for a full day, 0:00-24:00; the National Convention Hall, Conference Center, Annex Hall and North are rented by time category, such as 9:00-17:00 or 9:00-21:00. Load-in facilities of the National Convention Hall: freight elevator (W3.0 x D5.0 x H2.6 m, 4 t capacity), loading storage (W5.0 x H3.55 m) and lift pit (W5.0 x D6.8 x H2.85 m, 5.9 t capacity, only when the lift stage is used). The load-in/load-out entrance of the Conference Center Main Hall is W3.2 x H2.6 m. Vehicles can drive into the Exhibition Hall from the 1F loading entrance, up to 10.5 t. Parcel delivery loads in via the PACIFICO Logistics Center on the Exhibition Hall 2F. (Source: Facility Usage Regulations, Appendix 2; capacity and equipment list sheet; Exhibition Hall facility overview sheet; parcel load-in and load-out guide PDF)
ops.parking: There are 4 on-site parking lots. Minatomirai Public Parking (P1): 1,154 cars and 44 motorcycles, open 24 hours with entry 7:00-24:00, no reservations; vehicle limits are height 2.1 m, length 6.0 m, width 2.2 m and weight 4.0 t or less. North Parking (P4): 152 spaces (height 2.3 m, length 5.0 m, width 2.3 m, 3.5 t or less). Rinko Park Parking (P2): 90 spaces (height 2.0 m or less, 8:00-21:00, no overnight parking). Bus and large vehicle parking (P3): 8 spaces (entry and exit 7:00-22:00, reservation required, accepted from 1 month in advance). The maximum charge for P1 and North Parking from 7:00 to 24:00 is 1,800 yen on weekdays and 2,400 yen on Sat, Sun, holidays and specified days. (Source: Parking Guide PDF, official parking page)
ops.vehicleRules: Parking on public roads and cargo handling on the street are prohibited; for delivery vehicles, the user must secure a vehicle waiting area and assign guides and security staff. Waiting areas are paid and require advance application (up to 1 month before). There are 6 locations, including the seismic-resistant berth (1 block, 110,000 yen per 12 hours, 55,000 yen for load-out, about 40 vehicles), the piloti (110,000 yen per 12 hours, entry height up to 3.8 m, in principle for Exhibition Hall D users) and Yamauchi Wharf (Triangular Lot (Large) 6,300 m², about 180 vehicles, 554,400 yen per 12 hours, and others). On-site restrictions on the service passage: height 3.8 m or less, 8 km/h or less, 4 t vehicles or less (over 4 t, consult in advance). (Source: Vehicle Waiting Area Guide PDF, June 2024 edition; Explanation of Important Matters 2025.9)
